### feat: live feed — use Supabase uploaded videos

This PR replaces the mock/demo feed with the real uploaded videos from the Supabase `videos` table. It keeps the exact UI and mobile-first layout and adds a loading skeleton and an empty state.

What changed:
- src/routes/index.tsx
  - Removed usage of mock VIDEOS and now fetches live feed via `fetchFeed(category)` (from `src/lib/videos.ts`).
  - Renders `UploadedVideoCard` for each database row.

Notes for reviewers:
- Ensure the environment variables for Supabase are set (SUPABASE_URL & SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) when testing locally or in CI.
- The feed uses signed URLs generated by `src/lib/videos.ts` (supabase.storage.createSignedUrls) — be mindful of rate limits and signing many URLs at once. Consider pagination if you see performance overhead.

Smoke checklist (manual):
- [ ] With Supabase env vars configured, Home should render uploaded videos (status = 'published').
- [ ] Video playback works and triggers the `record_video_view` RPC for verified views.
- [ ] No service_role key is exposed in client code.
